title: Watercolor
look: Pale washes that bleed past their edges, a faint darker rim, paper grain.

doc.essence: Washes of pigment on cold-press paper: soft, light, bleeding a little beyond the drawing.
doc.notIt: Not crayon (no wax, no dark line).
doc.shapes: A faint darker rim; an offset bleed copy.
pitfalls: Light bodies on light paper: keep enough contrast with a palette tweak.
